import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('products/services/uk-offline-qa-quote')
source = base / 'raw/tender-feed.json'
raw = source.read_bytes()
feed = json.loads(raw)
terms = re.compile(r'\b(?:data quality|data validation|data cleansing|data reconciliation|data migration|data assurance|data audit|dataset|data integrity|deduplication)\b', re.I)
rows = []
for release in feed['releases'][:30]:
    tender = release.get('tender') or {}
    sections = [('tender', tender)] + [('lot', lot) for lot in tender.get('lots') or []]
    hits = []
    for kind, section in sections:
        for field in ('title', 'description'):
            value = section.get(field) or ''
            match = terms.search(value)
            if match:
                hits.append({'section': kind, 'id': section.get('id'), 'field': field, 'excerpt': value[max(0, match.start()-100):match.end()+140]})
    rows.append({'release_id': release.get('id'), 'ocid': release.get('ocid'), 'buyer': (release.get('buyer') or {}).get('name'), 'title': tender.get('title'), 'status': tender.get('status'), 'deadline_as_published': (tender.get('tenderPeriod') or {}).get('endDate'), 'document_links': [d['url'] for d in tender.get('documents') or [] if d.get('url')][:5], 'keyword_hits': hits})
report = {'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'coverage': 'First 30 feed releases. Keyword excerpts provide leads only. Review titles and lots for vocabulary the filter misses. Verify current status, separability and acceptance against original buyer documents.', 'scanned': len(rows), 'rows': rows}
out = base / 'director-feed-screen.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == report
print(json.dumps({'path': str(out), 'scanned': len(rows), 'releases_with_keyword_hits': sum(bool(row['keyword_hits']) for row in rows), 'source_sha256': report['source_sha256']}))
